statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail risk of 20% sits at the base of the watch band, at the 20% threshold and well below the 25% block level.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. A retracement of roughly 0.23% off the session high has now occurred while the gap above the prior record close stays unfilled, so conditions read as an orderly uptrend that still permits mean reversion rather than a one-way path. The narrow danger window covers the 3-year auction, the Fed Schmid speech and the power hour into the 20:00Z cash close.
headline: Nasdaq-100 retraces off its session high with the record-close gap intact; Tail eases to 20% at the watch-band base
body: The Nasdaq-100 trades at 31,290 (+0.69%) roughly three hours into the US cash session, with a session range of 31,208-31,361. Price has retraced about 0.23% from the high, so the shallow-pullback structure flagged an hour ago has given way to a genuine retracement, while the gap above Monday's 31,076 record close remains unfilled because the session low held well above it. Cross-asset confirmation is risk-on but not extreme: VIX is 15.17 (-2.26%) and printing at the low end of its 15.17-15.54 range, the 10-year yield has eased to 5.28% (-3bp) as the recent surge pauses, and the 30-year sits near 5.66%. Crude is soft, with WTI about 89.50 and Brent down 0.40% on a third consecutive session of declines. Leadership is narrow: Nvidia is up more than 1% with its market capitalisation approaching 6 trillion dollars, AMD has added around 2% after management pointed to demand outrunning supply, and cybersecurity names are up about 4%, yet the Russell 2000 is down 0.15%, which is a breadth divergence rather than broad participation. That mix keeps Stress elevated at 46% while Tail eases to 20%: an orderly retracement with decaying volatility is the opposite of the mean-reversion failure that Tail measures, but the unfilled gap, the trend-up mode and a stack of Fed speakers into the power hour prevent a drop into the low band. The shared Finviz context file was stale and only partially collected at assessment time, so it was not used; the assessment rests on verified primary-source levels instead.

lookbackSummary: All 24 hours to 15:00Z are covered by published Claude assessments. Tail ran 8-22%: a single WATCH print at 19:00Z on 05 October, then compression to 8-12% through the Asian and European overnight, followed by a steady climb from 13% at 10:00Z as the European and US sessions built the gap-up trend, reaching 19% at 14:00Z and a 22% WATCH print at 15:00Z when price was holding within 0.05% of the session high. Stress stayed in the elevated band for all 24 hours, ranging 45-54%, and confidence held between 86% and 88% throughout.
outlookSummary: The forecast keeps the watch band through the US afternoon, with Tail peaking at 22% in the 19:00Z power hour before easing to 21% at the 20:00Z cash close, then stepping down to 18% after the close and into the low band overnight, bottoming at 10% through the Asian session. It rebuilds gradually across the European morning and steps up to 18% for the 13:00Z slot containing the 07 October cash open, closing the window at 19% at 15:00Z. Confidence decays from 87% to 76% across the horizon, which reflects forecast distance rather than any current evidence gap. Every hour beyond the current one is conditional: no future price structure is treated as observed.

forecastDetail.comment: Observed structure: price has retraced about 0.23% off the 31,361 session high while the gap above the 31,076 record close remains unfilled, with VIX 15.17 at the day's low and the 10y easing to 5.28%. Orderly retracement keeps Tail at the base of the watch band.

The 3-year note auction at 17:00Z and Fed Schmid at 17:15Z fall in this hour. A soft auction tail or hawkish tone could restart the paused yield move, so Tail is nudged up conditionally rather than on observed structure.

Post-auction digestion. If the curve absorbs the auction and Schmid without a rate-path shift, the orderly retracement regime should persist; a one-way push above 31,361 with no pullback is the invalidation to watch.

Power hour is the conditional peak of the path. Late-session continuation on narrow, megacap-dependent leadership is the main scenario that could extend the trend without meaningful retracement. None of it is observed yet.

The 20:00Z cash close can produce a final directional impulse through index closing flows, but post-close liquidity decay normally ends any persistent intraday path, so Tail eases from the power-hour peak.

With cash trade finished, the mechanism that threatens mean reversion largely lapses and Tail steps down to the low band. Residual trend-up bias is carried by futures, not by observed index structure.
